messages:
Reena: Kicking off onboarding of Vera-7B (community fork) — quick smoke results attached. Noticed odd spike in token freq mass around id 49100-49120 compared to our tokenizer.

Dmitri: Can you paste the freq histogram? is it new tokens or shifted ids from merge? Could be pre-tokenizer normalization difference.

Reena: Histogram snippet:
```
most_common range 0-1000 consistent
spike: 49100: 0.87% -> 1.76% (our tokenizer -> vera's)
spike block length: 21 tokens
unmapped fallbacks: 12 (ZWJ/ZWJ combos)
```

Jules: That block size smells like a remap collision during conversion. If the exporter collapsed variation selectors or ligatures into single fallback tokens, you'll see a local mass shift. Also which rotary export format? per-head angles or global freq table?

Reena: Rotary export: single freq_table, no per-head metadata. head_dim=64, heads=16. export tool used: model-convert v0.9.2 with default tokenmap.

Dmitri: If token ids shifted, KV cache indexing could be wrong only when we mix tokenmaps between warm and new sessions. Did you validate repetition tests (generate with long prefex -> continue)?

Reena: Yes, we saw increased repetition in a 1k-step longctx continue test (small, but reproducible when prompts include emoji sequences). Suspect tokenmap shadowing + rotary phase mismatch.

ci-bot: auto-ci: onboard-smoke for vera-7b failed embedding-stability (4/40), queued ML-4532. See job 1762400200. :warning:

Jules: Plan: (1) re-run conversion with `--preserve-zwj` and `--explicit-tokenmap` to avoid implicit collisions, (2) run quant sweep: per-channel int8 -> per-channel int4 with KLD calibration, (3) craft a tokenmap shim to temporarily remap spike-block to an upper unused id range and run longctx generate probe.

Dmitri: Also try small rotary angle jitter experiment: multiply angles for head groups 8..15 by 0.998 to see if that reduces repeat bias — if phase alignment is slightly off, small rescale can sometimes mitigate aliasing.

Reena: I'll run converter with preserve flags now and enqueue the shim run. Starting KLD calibration sweep on a subset of 2000 tokens.

Jules: Add a quick perplexity check (LLR on held-dev) after remap+quant before we escalate to dedicated capacity. If perplexity shifts > 1.5% we hold.

Reena: Noted. Will post results in this thread (embedding diffs, llr delta, generation sample) when ready. Tagging @eng-ml for visibility. :rocket:
